command:
set -e

export CODER_URL="http://coder.coder.svc.cluster.local"

# Sync function
sync_templates() {
  echo "$(date): Starting template sync..."

  cd /tmp
  rm -rf /tmp/repo
  git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/jedarden/coder-templates.git /tmp/repo

  for template_dir in /tmp/repo/*/; do
    [ -f "$template_dir/main.tf" ] || continue

    template_name="$(basename "$template_dir")"
    echo "  Syncing template: $template_name"

    if coder templates versions list "$template_name" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      coder templates push "$template_name" \
        --directory "$template_dir" \
        --yes \
        --activate || echo "  Warning: Failed to push $template_name"
    else
      coder templates push "$template_name" \
        --directory "$template_dir" \
        --yes || echo "  Warning: Failed to create $template_name"
    fi
  done

  echo "$(date): Sync complete."
}

# Login to Coder
coder login --token "$CODER_API_TOKEN" "$CODER_URL"

# Initial sync on startup
sync_templates

# Simple webhook server using netcat
echo "Starting webhook server on port 8080..."
while true; do
  # Listen for incoming request
  REQUEST=$(echo -e "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n{\"status\":\"ok\"}" | nc -l -p 8080 -q 1)

  # Check if it's a POST request (GitHub webhook)
  if echo "$REQUEST" | grep -q "POST"; then
    echo "$(date): Webhook received, triggering sync..."
    sync_templates &
  fi
done
containers.name: sync

args:
set -e
VENV="/root/faster-whisper-server/.venv"
HF_CACHE="/root/.cache/huggingface/hub"

mkdir -p "$HF_CACHE"

DEEPDML_DIR="$HF_CACHE/models--deepdml--faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2"
if [ -d "$DEEPDML_DIR/snapshots" ]; then
  echo "Model already cached, skipping download"
else
  echo "Downloading deepdml/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2..."
  "$VENV/bin/python" -c "
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
result = snapshot_download(
    repo_id='deepdml/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2',
    cache_dir='$HF_CACHE',
)
print('Downloaded to:', result)
"
fi

# Systran/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo is gated. Symlink so offline
# cache lookup for "large-v3-turbo" resolves to the deepdml model.
SYSTRAN_DIR="$HF_CACHE/models--Systran--faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo"
if [ ! -e "$SYSTRAN_DIR" ]; then
  ln -s "models--deepdml--faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2" "$SYSTRAN_DIR"
  echo "Created symlink Systran -> deepdml"
else
  echo "Systran symlink already present"
fi

# Write launcher script via base64 to avoid YAML indentation issues.
# Script patches _MODELS to accept "large-v3-turbo" (older faster-whisper
# doesn't know this size; _MODELS is a tuple so we use concatenation).
echo '' | base64 -d > /root/.cache/huggingface/launch.py
echo "launch.py written"
echo "Init complete"
initContainers.name: model-download
